text:
Alex: opened PR to bump pyyaml to 6.0.1 — security patch for CVE-2026-0420, small change but want another pair of eyes before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123

Priya: thanks — quick skim looks small. does this affect any of our base images or runtime deserialization paths?

Alex: no API changes. changed `requirements.txt` and `docker/base/py/requirements.txt`. I built the image locally (make image) — +8MB. no config changes. CI flaked one integration test, re-run queued.

Ming: @Alex can you paste the exact diff?

Alex: ```diff
- pyyaml==5.4.1
+ pyyaml==6.0.1
```

Alex: CI jobs passing except `tests/integration/test-config-load` which failed once in CI but passed locally. re-running.

Jordan: @eng-sre heads-up — plan to canary this in prod pool-2 after merge. any concerns about deserialization or memory?

SRE-Bot: image-scan: passed; vuln-db: CVE-2026-0420 flagged and patched in PR; no secrets detected.

Priya: looking now, focusing on `yaml.load` usage. pyyaml 6 tightened loader defaults in several places. will leave inline comments on the PR.

Lewis: QA: if this lands, pls add to the regression set and ping QA channel. I'll run the smoke suite during canary.

Priya: note — pyyaml 6 changed `yaml.load` behaviour; we should switch to `yaml.safe_load` where we parse untrusted config. left a comment on the PR requesting a patch.

Alex: good catch. pushing follow-up to replace `yaml.load` -> `yaml.safe_load` in 3 places. will push in ~30m and retrigger CI.

Ming: also suggest a changelog entry mentioning the CVE and base image bump.

Alex: will add changelog. ETA 30m, then re-run CI and merge if green.

SRE-Bot: CI rerun triggered by Alex. queued jobs: unit, integration, image-scan.

Alex: update: pushed fix, CI rerun started.

Priya: LGTM now, leaving approval. :thumbsup:

Jordan: scheduling canary for 2026-06-01 09:00 UTC. @eng-oncall FYI.

Alex: thanks all — will merge once CI completes unless other concerns.

Ming: thanks, nice quick turnaround.

Lewis: I'll post QA run results in the canary thread tomorrow after smoke completes.
